steps.name: user clicks on the Hotels tab
user should be on the Hotels page

elements.name: User fills the hotel search form and clicks Search

steps.name: user is on the Hotels page
user enters the destination from Excel using row 1 and column 0
user selects the destination
user selects the check-in and check-out dates
user selects rooms and guests
user clicks on the Search Hotels button
user should see the hotel search results

elements.name: User sorts hotels, enters area from Excel, and applies multiple Most Popular filters

steps.name: user is on the hotel search results page
user opens the Popularity sort dropdown
user selects a random sort option
user enters area name from Excel using row 1 and column 1
user selects the first area suggestion
hotel results should update based on the selected sort and area
user scrolls to the Most Popular filter section
user selects a random filter option
hotel results should update based on selected filter
user scrolls back to the Most Popular filter section
user selects another random filter option
hotel results should update with both filters applied

elements.name: User applies filters from User Rating and Star Rating sections

steps.name: user has completed a hotel search and is viewing the results
user scrolls to the User Rating filter section
user selects a random option from User Rating
hotel results should update based on selected User Rating filter
user scrolls to the Star Rating filter section
user selects a random option from Star Rating
hotel results should update based on both applied filters

elements.name: Verify Book Now button redirects to the reservation page

steps.name: user has performed a hotel search and is viewing the search results
user clicks on the Book Now button of the first listed hotel
user should be redirected to the reservation page
